title: Overlapping binding sites underlie TF genomic occupancy
one_liner_zh: 该文开发PADIT-seq高灵敏检测TF-DNA低亲和力结合位点，揭示重叠结合位点调控基因组占据，虽为实验方法但聚焦TF-DNA互作且对结合位点预测有启发。
abstract: Sequence-specific DNA binding by transcription factors (TFs) is a crucial step in gene regulation. However, current high-throughput in vitro approaches cannot reliably detect lower affinity TF-DNA interactions, which play key roles in gene regulation. Here, we developed PADIT-seq ( p rotein a ffinity to D NA by in vitro transcription and RNA seq uencing) to assay TF binding preferences to all 10-bp DNA sequences at far greater sensitivity than prior approaches. The expanded catalogs of low affinity DNA binding sites for the human TFs HOXD13 and EGR1 revealed that nucleotides flanking high affinity DNA binding sites create overlapping lower affinity sites that together modulate TF genomic occupancy in vivo . Formation of such extended recognition sequences stems from an inherent property of TF binding sites to interweave each other and expands the genomic sequence space for identifying noncoding variants that directly alter TF binding. One-Sentence Summary Overlapping DNA binding sites underlie TF genomic occupancy through their inherent propensity to interweave each other.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）对DNA的序列特异性结合是基因调控中的关键步骤。然而，当前的高通量体外方法无法可靠检测低亲和力的TF-DNA相互作用，而这些相互作用在基因调控中扮演重要角色。在此，我们开发了PADIT-seq（通过体外转录和RNA测序测定蛋白质对DNA的亲和力），以远高于先前方法的灵敏度检测所有10-bp DNA序列上的TF结合偏好。对人类TF HOXD13和EGR1的低亲和力DNA结合位点扩展目录揭示，高亲和力DNA结合位点侧翼的核苷酸形成了重叠的低亲和力位点，这些位点共同调节TF在体内的基因组占据。这种扩展识别序列的形成源于TF结合位点相互交织的内在特性，并扩展了用于识别直接改变TF结合的非编码变异的基因组序列空间。一句话摘要：重叠的DNA结合位点通过其固有的相互交织倾向，构成TF基因组占据的基础。
